steps.declared_reload: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal
steps.health_check: grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-bridge.service && grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-http-bridge.service && grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-notifications.service && grep -q '"host_version": "0.7.1-beta"' /etc/nuxel/bridge-version.json && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal && systemctl show nuxel-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' && systemctl show nuxel-http-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta'
steps.rollback: restore every <target>.nuxel-rollback; `systemctl daemon-reload`; restart nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal
